parameter_transport.note: The local Lingxi /v1/chat schema exposes model directly but does not expose temperature/max_output_tokens as top-level fields. Those two values are sent as audit metadata and recorded as requested values; the worker must expose them separately to prove backend enforcement.

request_timing.scope: Lingxi /v1/chat round trip including the V2 agent loop

browser_budget.enforcement: worker-side browser_task_policy budget plus post-hoc V2 tool-event audit
browser_budget.reason: metadata.browser_task_policy v1 asks the worker to reject counted calls past the limit; each task records whether it was honoured

configuration.site_key_rules: dataset web_name, casefolded and whitespace normalized; hostname fallback only when web_name is empty

evidence_profile.capacity_method: conservative UTF-8 byte count plus 16384 tokens/image

final_evidence.binary_attachment_limitation: Lingxi ToolEnd omits binary model attachments; the runner captures the matching visible Chrome window read-only after V2 visual verification.
